slice: Email delivery E2a — provider adapter, templates, sender cron, retry/backoff

ci.note: GitHub Actions backlog; local tests, typecheck, eslint, build and acceptance ran before deployment

database.change: public flag probe for the sessionless sender cron and explicit service-role table grants

production.step: production sender rejects an unauthenticated cron call
production outbox stays disabled with the sender deployed

productionChecks.scheduler: vercel.json accepted two cron entries and the deployment is READY

honestLimits: Production has no provider and the flag is off, so the scheduled cron only reports provider-not-configured; no real email has ever been sent.

The console/console-fail adapters prove the queue, claim, idempotency, retry and recovery logic and the templates, but real provider error semantics (bounces, rate limits, auth) are untested until E2b.
Recipient addresses are resolved through the Supabase Auth admin API, so production E2b needs a service-role credential in Vercel env; it is absent today.
Retention for sent rows is not implemented yet (E3); the table is empty in production so nothing accumulates today.
